legend: Irregularly shaped, infiltrative mucinous glands and tumour clusters with evident nuclear atypia.
Tumoural glands are composed of mucinous cells with ample granular to foamy cytoplasm and distinct cell borders.
Poorly differentiated areas display frank infiltration and severe atypia. Notice the relatively abundant eosinophilic to vacuolated cytoplasm.

diagnosis: Gastric-type endocervical adenocarcinoma, minimal deviation type
legend: Proliferation of very well-differentiated glands with smooth contours, haphazardly distributed.

diagnosis: Gastric-type endocervical adenocarcinoma, minimal deviation type
legend: Glands are composed of tall columnar epithelium with abundant pale and foamy cytoplasm and distinct cell borders (compare with normal endocervical gland, top centre). Nuclear atypia (left aspect) can be encountered, but is usually a focal finding.

The wall of the cervix is diffusely involved by a destructively invasive glandular proliferation. Glands and tumour clusters are infiltrative and display significant nuclear atypia. Notice the ample eosinophylic granular to foamy cytoplasm and the distinct cell borders.

diagnosis: Gastric type adenocarcinoma with minimal deviation pattern
legend: Extremely well-differentiated gastric type endocervical adenocarcinoma, previously designated as minimal deviation adenocarcinoma or adenoma malignum. Although the tumor is morphologically bland, these tumors are aggressive with poor prognosis.
